input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: There is no minimum purchase commitment or volume cap on us: Section 3.1 charges HDI's 30% share only on actual Net Sales above $11,000 per month, and Section 6.1 is an exclusivity (not volume) restriction. However, Section 4.2(a) attaches a penalty to our only exit route: the one-year term auto-renews annually (Section 4.1) and if the Company gives the 90-day termination notice it must pay HDI half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000, in eight quarterly installments, for services it will never receive. That is a take-or-pay style charge on exit rather than a true-up, contrary to our position that fees are payable for usage or services actually delivered. Because HDI bears all design, hosting and promotion costs (Sections 1.2, 1.6, 1.8), outright deletion is disproportionate, so we take the fallback: cap the payment at HDI's documented unrecovered Site costs (a true-up) and disapply it where we terminate for HDI's breach or failure to launch under Section 1.6.

proposal.summary: Convert the Section 4.2 Termination Payment from a penalty into a cost true-up and disapply it where we terminate for HDI's non-performance.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that we pay only for services actually received, with no take-or-pay style charge for exiting. Section 4.2 would require us to pay HDI half of our own trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000 purely for exercising our termination right, so we have limited it to a true-up of HDI's documented unrecovered Site costs and excluded terminations caused by HDI's breach or failure to launch under Section 1.6.

ops.oldText: In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: In the event the Company terminates this Agreement other than as a result of HDI's breach or failure to perform (including any failure described in Section 1.6), the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the lesser of (i) the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two, and (ii) HDI's documented costs actually incurred in the design, development, implementation, operation, maintenance and management of the Site and not recovered through payments made by the Company under Section 3 as of the Termination Date.
